name: Noah
summary: A righteous man who walked with God when the earth was full of violence. God had him build an ark that saved his family and the animals from the flood, then promised never to flood the earth again.

key_moments.title: Build an Ark
key_moments.description: Noah found grace with the LORD at a time when the earth was full of violence. God told him to build an ark of gopher wood, and Noah did everything God commanded.

key_moments.title: Into the Ark
key_moments.description: Noah, his wife, his sons and their wives went into the ark with the animals, two by two, and the LORD shut them in, while rain fell on the earth for forty days and nights.

key_moments.title: The Dove and the Olive Leaf
key_moments.description: God remembered Noah, the waters went down, and the ark came to rest on the mountains of Ararat. Noah sent out a dove, and when it came back with an olive leaf, he knew the waters were going down.

key_moments.title: The Rainbow Promise
key_moments.description: Noah built an altar and offered burnt offerings to the LORD. God made a covenant never again to destroy the earth with a flood, and set a rainbow in the clouds as its sign.

key_moments.title: Noah's Vineyard
key_moments.description: Noah planted a vineyard, became drunk, and lay uncovered in his tent. His son Ham saw and told his brothers, Shem and Japheth covered their father, and Noah cursed Ham's son Canaan.
